text.p: Computer services firm Computer Power Group Ltd said on Monday that its chairman Roger Allen had resigned from the company following the sale of his 11 percent stake to institutions and retail investors.
The company said Allen would be replaced as chairman by deputy chairman George Bradbury.
Computer Power managing director Peter James said Allen's departure was amicable and had been expected by the company and institutional investors.
Allen had decided to form an investment bank called Allen and Buckeridge with offices in Sydney, California's Silicon Valley, Melbourne and Brisbane, James told Reuters.
He said the company's shares were now held by a wide range of institutions. News Corp sold its 18.6 percent holding in early June.

Allen said in a separate statement that the investment bank he had formed with information technology expert Dr Roger Buckeridge was nearing the first close of a specialist A$100 million venture capital fund.
